title: jobs: two jobs of one name compose and the boot schedules neither (residual and two-body)
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Follow-up from #35711 (PR #36338, a composed artifact's residual extension and jobs). The L2 (S2) and L1 found it from the code; filed by the seat. Parent: #35711.

## What happens

A residual job that shares its name with a package body's job, with different content, still composes. The job binder (`jobNameCollisions`) counts by name and refuses both, so the boot schedules neither. Two package bodies that share a job name end the same way, and a CONTROL test in #36338 pins that they compose.

## To do

1. Decide where a job name clash is judged: at composition (refuse the pair, a further narrowing) or at the binder with a clear boot message naming both sources.
2. Make one place own it, and pin both the residual and the two-body case.

## Acceptance

- Two jobs of one name never compose into a boot that silently schedules neither.

Blocked-by: #36338

## Grade
p2 · area:package · domain:server. Silent loss of scheduled work.
